method: Item SEO Tags resolvedTags (List/Get); enabled primary = BlogPosting|Article with disabled!==true

strategy.name: item_disabled_suppressor_for_pattern_BlogPosting
strategy.description: Keep enriched item #article BlogPosting; add item-level copy of pattern BlogPosting with disabled:true and meta.schemaType=blog-post-blog-posting-preset to suppress default pattern primary on that page. Do NOT put preset schemaType on the live #article node.
rejectedStrategies: global pattern disable/remove (44+ default-only posts would go to 0; pattern Set unreliable)

before.note: Initial resolvedTags inventory counted all primary nodes including disabled=false only after strategy lock; pre-fix raw resolved primary counts were 1=44,2=451,3=18 (some later scans reported 1=14 after A-default enrichment).

outlierFix.rootCause: Item #article BlogPosting incorrectly carried meta.schemaType=blog-post-blog-posting-preset; disabled pattern suppressor then zeroed all matching preset nodes in resolvedTags (enabledPrimary=0).
outlierFix.fix: STRIP meta.schemaType from #article; keep disabled suppressor with schemaType blog-post-blog-posting-preset; preserve full tags+focusKeywords
